IDS makes its GMSL2 Discovery Kit available for evaluation

IDS has announced evaluation access to its GMSL2 Discovery Kit, combining multiple cameras with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX embedded computer after a VISION 2026 preview. It targets robot and mobile-machine developers testing architectures before building production systems.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗10 November 2026English editorial summary
Story

An embedded-vision evaluation kit

IDS has announced evaluation access to its GMSL2 Discovery Kit, combining multiple cameras with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX embedded computer after a VISION 2026 preview. It targets robot and mobile-machine developers testing architectures before building production systems.

Several signals on one cable

Camera modules use onsemi AR0233 sensors for Full HD at 30 frames per second, with onboard ISP and SoC, HDR and LED flicker mitigation. GMSL carries images, control, synchronization and power over one cable. Drivers expose camera data through V4L2.

Evaluate against the application

Developers can work in Python and OpenCV or stream through RTSP. Camera counts depend on the kit version. IDS offers loans with technical support and subsequent custom development; access to a kit does not establish latency or robustness compliance for every application without testing.
